name: temp-check
title: Temp Check
description: Monitor your Mac's CPU temperature from the menu bar with real-time updates and thermal alerts
author: ADCAdams

commands.name: menubar-temperature
commands.title: Menu Bar Temperature
commands.description: Show CPU temperature in the macOS menu bar

commands.name: temperature-monitor
commands.title: Temp Check
commands.description: View detailed CPU temperature readings with chip info and thermal sensor breakdown

preferences.name: temperatureUnit
preferences.title: Temperature Unit
preferences.description: Display temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
preferences.description: How often to poll temperature data in the list view

preferences.name: warningThreshold
preferences.title: Warning Threshold (°C)
preferences.description: Temperature above which a warning color is shown (in Celsius)

preferences.name: criticalThreshold
preferences.title: Critical Threshold (°C)
preferences.description: Temperature above which a critical alert is shown (in Celsius)

scripts.prebuild: clang -Wall -O2 -fobjc-arc -arch arm64 -arch x86_64 tools/temp-reader.m -framework IOKit -framework Foundation -o assets/temperature-reader
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
